课程简介（中文）

《英语论辩与思辨》课程将选取教育、经济、环境、科技、社会、国际政治等方面的争议性话题进行探讨，采用线上线下讲授、演讲及辩论操练、测验与评价相结合的授课方式，从立证、驳论入手，帮助学生系统地认识和辨别逻辑谬误，掌握有效的英语表达和沟通技巧，学会分辨事实与观点，学会分析和评估论证。

课程简介（英文）

The course “Critical Thinking in English Argumentation” will explore controversial topics in education, economics, the environment, technology, society, and international politics. It adopts a teaching approach that combines online and offline lectures, speech and debate practice, as well as quizzes and evaluations. Starting with argument construction and refutation, the course aims to help students systematically recognize and identify logical fallacies, master effective English expression and communication skills, and learn to distinguish facts from opinions, as well as analyze and evaluate arguments.

教学目标

《英语论辩与思辨》课程适用于《中国英语能力等级量表》中熟练阶段（七至九级）的学习者。《英语论辩与思辨》课的教学目的包含：

价值目标：立德树人，明辨是非，树立正确的价值观；

知识目标：了解论证的基本结构和方法，认识和辨别逻辑谬误，了解不同类型（事实、价值、政策）话题的特点和谋篇方式，学习英语辩论赛制；

能力目标：培养学生构建和分析英语论证的能力、逻辑思维能力、有效进行英语驳论的能力、主动学习的能力、信息素养及开展学术研究的能力、有效沟通和合作能力、跨文化交际意识及能力。

通过本课程的修读，学生应达到《中国英语能力等级量表》中语言理解能力、语言表达能力、语用能力、语言知识、语言使用策略等相关能力的八级或以上水平。

教学方式

其他：本课程采用线上线下混合式教学模式，依托超星复旦大学教学平台及eLearning复旦教学平台。课堂教学以授课与全班研讨、小组研讨活动相结合为主，突出思辨与论辩的应用能力培养，详见主讲教师的授课方式说明。

教学内容与进度安排

Week 1 Classroom: Introduction to the Course & Argumentation Model: Toulmin’s

  1. To learn about course purpose, rules, evaluation and resources
  2. To learn basic components of argumentation

Week 2 Classroom: Analysis on Grounds and Practice

  1. To learn basic types of evidence
  2. To apply evidence in argumentation

Week 3 Classroom: Analysis on Warrant (Perspectives, Logic & First Principles) and Practice

  1. To learn about basic reasoning methods
  2. To learn and practice induction and deduction
  3. To know first principles and their importance in argumentation

Week 4 Online: Debating Format and Role Fulfillment (WUDC)

  1. To learn about the mainstream university debating tournament format
  2. To learn about the basic roles of WUDC format
  3. To practice each role and POI

Week 5 Classroom: The First Debate & Adjudication: Taylor Swift deserves her billion dollars fortune.

  1. To practice constructive speeches and rebuttals
  2. To learn how to evaluate the quality of debate speeches

Week 6 Classroom: Motions of Fact, Value, Policy & Analysis on Value structures

  1. To learn about different types of motions and worldview
  2. To understand the speech structure for value motions
  3. To drill on value motions

Week 7 Online: Logical Fallacies and Refutation

  1. To learn about Johnson & Blair’s Argument Cogency Model
  2. To know basic kinds of logical fallacies
  3. To prepare typical or interesting logical fallacies for class analysis

Week 8 Classroom: Logical Fallacies and Refutation Practice

  1. To categorize logical fallacies into main categories
  2. To analyze logical fallacy examples
  3. To practice refutation logical fallacies

Week 9 Classroom: The Second Debate & Adjudication & Analysis on Policy structures: Minimum wage shall be abolished.

  1. To understand structures for policy motions
  2. To drill on different components of policy motions

Week 10 Online: Reading: Justice: What’s the Right Thing to Do

  1. To learn about utilitarianism, liberalism and distribution justice
  2. To prepare group presentation with peers

Week 11 Classroom: Reading Report and Discussion: Justice: What’s the Right Thing to Do

  1. Group presentation of chose chapters/topics
  2. Analysis and feedback

Week 12 Classroom: Reading Report and Discussion: Justice: What’s the Right Thing to Do

  1. Group presentation of chosen chapters/topics
  2. Analysis and feedback

Week 13 Online: Stakeholder Analysis

  1. To learn about the importance of SA
  2. To learn about how to do SA

Week 14 Classroom: The Third Debate & Adjudication: Online anonymity shall be banned.

  1. To learn how to evaluate debate holistically
  2. To learn teamwork and team competition

Week 15 Test on Argumentation and Critical Thinking Competence

Week 16 Final Exam (Debate)
